children: White Pearl Technology Group AB (publ) ("WPTG" or the "Group") announces that Aixia Group AB (publ) ("Aixia"), a company within the WPTG Group, has received an order from an existing global customer in the telecommunications sector valued at approximately SEK 3 million. The order comprises advanced network infrastructure for high-performance and data-intensive IT environments. Delivery is expected during Q4 2026. The full announcement from Aixia follows below.

Aixia has received an order from an existing global customer within the telecommunications sector, with a total value of approximately SEK 3 million. The order includes advanced networking infrastructure for high-performance and data-intensive IT environments. Delivery is expected during the fourth quarter of 2026.

The solution is designed to improve the efficiency of network traffic processing, security and data handling in modern data centres. By moving parts of the processing from traditional server resources into the underlying infrastructure, organisations can improve performance, scalability and overall resource utilisation.

The order represents a further step in Aixia's long-standing relationship with the customer and confirms the company's position as a strategic partner for advanced IT infrastructure in environments with demanding requirements for performance, security and availability.
Mattias Bergkvist, CEO of Aixia and Deputy Group CEO of White Pearl Technology Group, comments:

“The continued confidence from one of our larger existing customers is highly significant for us. We are seeing a clear shift where networking, security and data processing are becoming increasingly integrated parts of modern data centre architecture. This is an area where Aixia has developed strong expertise and where we see continued attractive business opportunities.”
The order value amounts to SEK 3 million, with delivery expected during Q4 2026.
The company's Certified Adviser is Amudova AB

White Pearl Technology Group AB (WPTG) is a Swedish global technology company specialising in digital transformation solutions. With a presence in over 20 countries and a team of 950 experts, WPTG helps organisations navigate the complexities of the digital age, offering services ranging from ICT and system integration to business software and digital innovation. The company is listed on Nasdaq First North (WPTGB) in Stockholm, Sweden and on OTCQX (WPTGF) in the U.S.
